restrictions: Preserve attribution to MediQAl and its cited Scientific Data publication.
Exclude all test rows and normalized question overlaps with test from authoring.

citation: Bazoge A. MediQAl: A French Medical Question Answering Dataset for Knowledge and Reasoning Evaluation. Scientific Data. 2026.
notes: Pinned inventory contains 32,603 rows: 17,017 MCQU, 10,617 MCQM and 4,969 test-only OEQ.
Train and validation contain 19,907 candidate rows before test-overlap and PII filtering.
Normalized question overlaps measured: train/test 399, train/validation 478, validation/test 112.
MCQ answers measure medical examination knowledge, not triage priority.
The artifact hash is SHA-256 over the ordered SHA-256 listing of the four authoring input files.
